pairs.evidence: src/components/modules/game-systems/PreflightPanel.tsx:219 When a re-run of the fast check cannot run, the error goes only to tile state while the previous pass stays in results and the summary omits errors, so the header still reads ready and a Package press cooks on the old verdict, routing could-not-run to pass on a gate whose green authorizes shipping.

techniques.evidence: src/components/modules/game-systems/PreflightPanel.tsx:219 The failed request returns before touching results, and onStatusChange carries no error field, so decide() in package-flow sees the held pass and releases the cook. A first-ever failure is safe, because no held verdict means no release.

src/lib/packaging/package-flow.ts:120 The override event names no finding, so one Package anyway click waives every failing and every unmeasured check together: a blanket. It is a one-shot, so the reaper rule does not apply.

src/app/api/packaging/execute/route.ts:48 The cook request carries no override or not-measured fields and the finalize and history stores have none, so the build row never records that a blocked gate was waived. The disclosure lasts only as long as the on-screen flow state.
